# Spreadsheet: Paycheck Budget

## Buyer
People paid monthly who want to know, any evening, what is still safe to spend before the next paycheck.
- Not for: bookkeeping a business, or households that want bank sync.

## Promise
Log every payment in one list and see what is left, what is safe to spend per day until payday, and where the money went.

## Tabs
| Tab | Job |
| --- | --- |
| start | explains the three steps to start and what each tab does |
| settings | sets the month to show, the next payday and the savings goal |
| categories | names the categories with their monthly budgets and shows what is left of each |
| log | holds every payment and income, one row each |
| dashboard | shows income, spending, what is left and safe to spend per day |
| year | shows what each category cost in every month |
